(const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t        // Compute bounding box\n187\t        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188\t        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189\t        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190\t            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) {\n307\t                if (children[i]->applyToTris(p1, p2, func)) return true;\n308\t            }\n309\t        }\n310\t        return false;\n311\t    }\n312\t};\n313\t\n314\t// ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t            if (i == j) continue;\n598\t            state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeKij(\n599\t                i, j, state.triangles, state.octree, rng);\n600\t        }\n601\t        if ((i + 1) % 100 == 0 || i + 1 == state.numTriangles) {\n602\t            printf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", i + 1, state.numTriangles);\n603\t        }\n604\t    }\n605\t}\n606\t\n607\tvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n608\t    printf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n609\t\n610\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n611\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n612\t            if (i == j) continue;\n613\t            state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)] = computeTau(\n614\t                state.triangles[i], state.triangles[j]);\n615\t        }\n616\t    }\n617\t}\n618\t\n619\t// ============================================================================\n620\t// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n621\t// ============================================================================\n622\t\n623\tvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n624\t    printf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n625\t\n626\t    for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n627\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n628\t            val_t sumB = ZERO;\n629\t\n630\t            for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n631\t                if (i == j) continue;\n632\t\n633\t                int tauij = state.tau[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n634\t\n635\t                // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n636\t                if (static_cast<int>(t) < tauij) continue;\n637\t\n638\t                val_t kij = state.kij[state.idx2d(i, j)];\n639\t                if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n640\t\n641\t                // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n642\t                size_t srcTime = t - static_cast<size_t>(tauij);\n643\t                val_t radJ = state.radB[state.idxTN(srcTime, j)];\n644\t                if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n645\t\n646\t                // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n647\t                sumB += std::min(kij * state.areas[j], ONE) * radJ;\n648\t            }\n649\t\n650\t            // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n651\t            state.radB[state.idxTN(t, i)] = state.rho[i] * sumB + state.radE[state.idxTN(t, i)];\n652\t        }\n653\t\n654\t        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == state.numTimesteps) {\n655\t            printf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, state.numTimesteps);\n656\t        }\n657\t    }\n658\t}\n659\t\n660\t// ============================================================================\n661\t// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n662\t// {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfhy9B2Ww3YL2WbfS2z95","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01QsnUoL6bmQyuG53esYQuaC","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/tmp/mid.cpp","content":"// ============================================================================\n// Error Checking Helpers\n// ============================================================================\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                        \\\n        cudaError_t err__ = (call);                                             \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                             \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                         \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__), __FILE__, __LINE__);             \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                       \\\n        }                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mersenne Twister (std::mt19937) Jump-Ahead\n// ============================================================================\n//\n// The sequential code draws every random number from a single std::mt19937\n// stream (seed 42), consuming 4 * NUM_RAYS numbers for each (i, j) pair that is\n// not culled, in row-major order. To reproduce exactly the same numbers in\n// parallel, each worker starts at its own offset in that stream. The start\n// states are obtained with the polynomial jump-ahead method over GF(2):\n//   1. the characteristic polynomial p(x) of the MT transition is recovered\n//      with Berlekamp-Massey from 2 * 19937 output bits,\n//   2. x^J mod p(x) is computed by square-and-multiply,\n//   3. the jumped state is sum_k g_k A^k S, evaluated with Horner's rule.\n\nnamespace mtjump {\n\nconstexpr int MT_N = 624;\nconstexpr int MT_M = 397;\nconstexpr int MEXP = 19937;\nconstexpr uint32_t MATRIX_A = 0x9908b0dfU;\nconstexpr uint32_t UPPER_MASK = 0x80000000U;\nconstexpr uint32_t LOWER_MASK = 0x7fffffffU;\nconstexpr int PW = (MEXP + 1 + 63) / 64;   // words of a polynomial of degree <= MEXP\nconstexpr int SW = 2 * PW + 2;             // words of a product (with slack)\n\nusing Poly = std::vector<uint64_t>;\nusing MTState = std::array<uint32_t, MT_N>;  // window (x_k, ..., x_{k+623})\n\ninline int getBit(const uint64_t* a, size_t k) { return (a[k >> 6] >> (k & 63)) & 1; }\ninline void flipBit(uint64_t* a, size_t k) { a[k >> 6] ^= (uint64_t(1) << (k & 63)); }\n\n// 64 bits of a starting at bit offset o (a must be padded by one word)\ninline uint64_t get64(const uint64_t* a, size_t o) {\n    size_t w = o >> 6, b = o & 63;\n    return b ? ((a[w] >> b) | (a[w + 1] << (64 - b))) : a[w];\n}\n\n// dst ^= src << shift  (src has n words)\ninline void xorShifted(uint64_t* __restrict dst, const uint64_t* __restrict src, int n, size_t shift) {\n    size_t ws = shift >> 6, bs = shift & 63;\n    uint64_t* d = dst + ws;\n    if (bs == 0) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) d[i] ^= src[i];\n    } else {\n        d[0] ^= src[0] << bs;\n        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) d[i] ^= (src[i] << bs) | (src[i - 1] >> (64 - bs));\n        d[n] ^= src[n - 1] >> (64 - bs);\n    }\n}\n\n// Initial std::mt19937 state window for a given seed\nMTState seedState(uint32_t seed) {\n    MTState s;\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (int i = 1; ((a[w] >> b) | (a[w + 1] << (64 - b))) : a[w];\n}\n\n// dst ^= src << shift  (src has n words)\ninline void xorShifted(uint64_t* __restrict dst, const uint64_t* __restrict src, int n, size_t shift) {\n    size_t ws = shift >> 6, bs = shift & 63;\n    uint64_t* d = dst + ws;\n    if (bs == 0) {\n        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) d[i] ^= src[i];\n    } else {\n        d[0] ^= src[0] << bs;\n        for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) d[i] ^= (src[i] << bs) | (src[i - 1] >> (64 - bs));\n        d[n] ^= src[n - 1] >> (64 - bs);\n    }\n}\n\n// Initial std::mt19937 state window for a given seed\nMTState seedState(uint32_t seed) {\n    MTState s;\n    s[0] = seed;\n    for (int i = 1; i < MT_N; ++i)\n        s[i] = 1812433253U * (s[i - 1] ^ (s[i - 1] >> 30)) + static_cast<uint32_t>(i);\n    return s;\n}\n\nclass Jumper {\npublic:\n    Poly p;                           // characteristic polynomial, degree MEXP\n    std::vector<uint64_t> redTable;   // 256 x PW reduction table for 8-bit chunks\n\n    explicit Jumper(uint32_t seed) {\n        computeCharPoly(seed);\n        buildTable();\n    }\n\n    // x^e mod p\n    Poly powX(uint64_t e) const {\n        Poly r(PW, 0);\n        r[0] = 1;\n        bool started = false;\n        for (int b = 63; b >= 0; --b) {\n            if (started) r = sqrMod(r);\n            if ((e >> b) & 1) {\n                r = mulX(r);\n                started = true;\n            }\n        }\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    Poly sqrMod(const Poly& a) const {\n        std::vector<uint64_t> buf(SW + 1, 0);\n        for (int i = 0; i < PW; ++i) {\n            buf[2 * i] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[i]));\n            buf[2 * i + 1] = spread(static_cast<uint32_t>(a[i] >> 32));\n        }\n        return reduce(buf, 2 * MEXP - 2);\n    }\n\n    Poly mulX(const Poly& a) const {\n        Poly r(PW, 0);\n        uint64_t carry = 0;\n        for (int i = 0; i < PW; ++i) {\n            r[i] = (a[i] << 1) | carry;\n            carry = a[i] >> 63;\n        }\n        if (getBit(r.data(), MEXP))\n            for (int i = 0; i < PW; ++i) r[i] ^= p[i];\n        return r;\n    }\n\n    // Returns sum_k g_k A^k s, i.e. the window advanced by J when g = x^J mod p.\n    // (Only the low 31 bits of word 0 may differ; they never influence output.)\n    static MTState apply(const Poly& g, const MTState& s) {\n        uint32_t r[2 * MT_N];\n        std::memset(r, 0, sizeof(r));\n        int pos = 0;\n        int k = MEXP - 1;\n        while (k >= 0 && !getBit(g.data(), k)) --k;\n        for (; k >= 0; --k) {\n            // r = A r\n            uint32_t y = (r[pos] & UPPER_MASK) | (r[pos + 1 < MT_N ? pos + 1 : 0] & LOWER_MASK);\n            int pm = pos + MT_M;\n            if (pm >= MT_N) pm -= MT_N;\n            r[pos] = r[pm] ^ (y >> 1) ^ ((y & 1U) ? 1 - k);\n\n        const int CW = N / 64 + 4;\n        std::vector<uint64_t> C(CW + 2, 0), B(CW + 2, 0), T;\n        C[0] = 1;\n        B[0] = 1;\n        int L = 0, m = 1;\n        for (int n = 0; n < N; ++n) {\n            size_t o = static_cast<size_t>(N - 1 - n);\n            uint64_t acc = 0;\n            int nw = L / 64 + 1;\n            for (int w = 0; w < nw; ++w) acc ^= C[w] & get64(rev.data(), o + 64 * size_t(w));\n            int d = __builtin_parityll(acc);\n            if (!d) {\n                ++m;\n                continue;\n            }\n            int bw = std::min(CW - m / 64 - 1, L / 64 + 2);\n            if (2 * L <= n) {\n                T = C;\n                xorShifted(C.data(), B.data(), bw, m);\n                L = n + 1 - L;\n                B = T;\n                m = 1;\n            } else {\n                xorShifted(C.data(), B.data(), bw, m);\n                ++m;\n            }\n        }\n        if (L != MEXP) {\n            fprintf(stderr, \"MT jump: unexpected linear complexity %d\\n\", L);\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n        }\n        p.assign(PW, 0);\n        for (int k = 0; k <= MEXP; ++k)\n            if (getBit(C.data(), MEXP - k)) flipBit(p.data(), k);\n    }\n};\n\n}  // namespace mtjump\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Tau (time delay) Computation\n// ============================================================================\n\nint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device Data Structures\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct DevTri {\n    float ax, ay, az;       // vertex a\n    float e1x, e1y, e1z;    // b - a\n    float e2x, e2y, e2z;    // c - a\n    float nx, ny, nz;       // normal\n};\n\nstruct DevNode {\n    float cx, cy, cz;       // center\n    float hx, hy, hz;       // half extent\n    int child[8];           // -1 if absent\n    int triStart, triCount; // leaf triangle range (triCount > 0 for leaves)\n};\n\nconstexpr int FF_THREADS = 256;                       // threads per form-factor block\nconstexpr int RANDS_PER_PAIR = 4 * NUM_RAYS;          // 64 random numbers per pair\nconstexpr int FF_PAIRS = FF_THREADS / NUM_RAYS;       // 16 pairs per batch\nconstexpr int FF_RBUF = FF_PAIRS * RANDS_PER_PAIR + mtjump::MT_N;\nconstexpr int OCT_STACK = 96;\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device Geometry Kernels\n// ============================================================================\n\n__device__ __forceinline__ float rayTriangleIntersectDev(\n    float ox, float oy, float oz, float dx, float dy, float dz, const DevTri& t) {\n    const float FMAX = 3.40282347e+38f;\n    // pvec = dir x e2\n    float px = dy * t.e2z - {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfhzp8hagnCFBdbYCp6pt","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"`roomsim` now runs as a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program, and its output is byte-for-byte identical to the original apart from the timing lines. I compared full outputs (`-o -v`) at n = 20, 80, 320, 1280 and 5120, plus several `-t/-s/-r` variations, on 1 and 3 ranks. The hashes also match on 2 and 4 ranks.\n\n| n | Original (1 core) | 1 GPU | 4 GPUs (4 ranks) |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 320 | 1.47 s | 27 ms | ~26 ms |\n| 1280 | 26.5 s | 77 ms | — |\n| 5120 | 467 s | 0.69 s | 0.25 s |\n| 20480 | many hours (estimated) | 12.7 s | 3.4 s |\n\nAt n=20480 I couldn't check against the original because it would take too long to run. The 1-rank and 4-rank runs do give the same hash there.\n\n**How the work is split**\n- **Random numbers:** the original draws every ray sample from one sequential `std::mt19937` stream, so splitting the work naively would change the results. I added an exact \"jump-ahead\" for the Mersenne Twister: each GPU block jumps straight to its own position in that stream. Every triangle pair therefore sees exactly the same samples as in the sequential run.\n- **MPI:** receiver triangles (rows) are divided evenly across ranks, one GPU per rank. Each rank only stores its own share of the form-factor and delay matrices. After each timestep the ranks exchange the new radiosity values, and rank 0 collects the final distances and does all the printing.\n- **CUDA:**\n  - Form factors run on the GPU. Each block handles a contiguous range of pairs, generates its random numbers in shared memory, and traces rays through a flattened copy of the original octree that visits exactly the same leaves.\n  - The time-stepping keeps the original summation order over `j`, which is why results match bit for bit.\n  - The distance cross-correlation also runs on the GPU.\n- **OpenMP:** host-side setup (pair culling, time delays). The delays are computed on the CPU while the GPU is tracing rays.\n\n**Changes you'll notice**\n- `CMakeLists.txt` now compiles `roomsim.cpp` as CUDA and links MPI, OpenMP and the CUDA runtime. It needs CMake 3.24 or newer, and the GPU architecture defaults to `native` (set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to override).\n- Run it as `mpirun -np <number of GPUs> ./roomsim ...`. If `OMP_NUM_THREADS` isn't set, each rank uses its share of the node's cores. I recommend `--bind-to none` or an equivalent per-rank CPU allocation. Open MPI's default core binding for two ranks only cost about 5% at n=5120.\n- The delay matrix is stored as bytes. That is safe because the room radius is fixed at 10, which keeps delays at 41 or less. The program stops with an error if a delay ever exceeds 255.\n\n**One caveat:** results match exactly because the GPU's rounding happens to agree with what GCC produces for the original. That held at every size I tested. In principle, an untested input could hit an edge case where a ray-visibility threshold rounds differently. The two checks where that would matter most (which pairs get culled, and the delays) are computed on the CPU with the original code."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":520,"cache_read_input_tokens":166800,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":520},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"6057524d-8ef0-442a-ba14-88c749ca0b45","uuid":"98c2bd99-7fbf-47fd-933b-90872ac67a08","timestamp":"2026-10-04T22:37:35.780Z","request_id":"req_011Cfhzp8EHzu4LFETyaK2ep"}
